Resolves #9872

Related: #9486

Moves locked-body (`bodyStart` / `bodyEnd`) config ownership, cloning/retirement lifecycle, retired-VNode unlinking, horizontal-scrollbar inset release, and `'neo-hide-scrollbar'` wrapper-class synchronization out of `Neo.grid.Container#createOrUpdateSubGrids` into `Neo.grid.View#updateBodies()`, completing the 3-tier orchestration architecture (`Container` → `header.Wrapper` + `grid.View`, [#issuecomment-6697421127](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/9872#issuecomment-6697421127)) while preserving read-only `@protected` delegating `bodyStart` / `bodyEnd` accessors on `Neo.grid.Container` and simplifying all 9 per-body fan-outs to `this.view.bodies` (`-132` / `+41` lines in `src/grid/Container.mjs`).

> **13.4 Release-Cut Coordination Note (`ROADMAP.md` L47, flagged by `@neo-opus-ada`):** `ROADMAP.md` lists `#9872` under `Deferred — explicitly off the 13.4 path`. Hold merge until after the `13.4.0` cut unless `@neo-opus-grace` and `@tobiu` elect to include it in `13.4.0` to close `#9872` toward the `<25` Engine issue gate.

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline lint-staged + unit-tests ran` (`§3.1` class: `capability` → `feat`).

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit suite covering `Neo.grid.View#updateBodies`, `View#bodyStart` / `View#bodyEnd` ownership, `Container#bodyStart` / `Container#bodyEnd` delegation, scrollbar inset release, `wrapperCls` `'neo-hide-scrollbar'` synchronization, and `onColumnLockChange` mid-flight destroy tolerance across 379 `test/playwright/unit/grid/` specs) → L1 required (unit-level component orchestration refactor).

| 2. `Neo.grid.header.Wrapper` orchestrates `headerStart`, `headerToolbar`, and `headerEnd` | Already shipped on `dev` (`src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs#updateHeaders`); verified intact by `test/playwright/unit/grid/LockedColumns.spec.mjs` |
| 3. `Neo.grid.View` owns `bodyStart` and `bodyEnd` creation, retirement, VNode unlinking, scrollbar inset release, and `wrapperCls` synchronization via `updateBodies()` | `test/playwright/unit/grid/LockedSubGridConfigs.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/grid/ViewOwnedSelectionModel.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/grid/ScrollManagerHoverSyncRouting.spec.mjs` |
